276959537.description:
Fossil Fish Specimen
Natural Stone Matrix, Prehistoric Aquatic Life
Stone, Approximately 7 x 7 x 2 Inches
This genuine prehistoric fossilized fish specimen is preserved within a natural sedimentary stone matrix. Such fossils provide a fascinating look at ancient marine or freshwater ecosystems, showcasing the delicate preservation of biological structures over millions of years. This particular piece displays prominent anatomical features, making it an excellent educational tool or addition to a natural history collection.
Natural stone matrix containing a detailed fossil fish impression
Visible skeletal features including the spine, head, and fin structure
Compact nodule-style matrix suitable for display or study
Measurements: Approximately 7 inches long by 7 inches wide and 2 inches thick; Weight: 2.1 lbs
Condition:
The fossilized remains are well-defined within the surrounding stone. The matrix exhibits natural texture, fissures, and color variations consistent with genuine geological specimens. No evidence of artificial restoration or composite assembly. The perimeter and base of the stone are raw and unpolished as excavated. Includes plastic storage container with cotton padding.
